rules.rule: FACE_ID_2001 pointer field1 holds actual runtime external-owner pointers. Integer field3 holds auxiliary id followed by helper-produced signed owner mirrors. mo_genAttribList uses a separate temporary pointer-sized -1/local or nonnegative ordered-list representation.

43b39d00 is reached by an actual null owner pointer in the bounded <=256-owner branch. A nonnull owner invokes helper +0x20 with null entity context and returns its actual moExtObject f78; nonnegative zero remains a valid list index.

When explicitly requested, backend repair calls helper +0x10 using the actual entity, signed mirror address and output owner. The model helper resolves BODY_RECIPE ownership, active model+d78 configuration and actual FR manager; index0 is looked up rather than interpreted as null. Fallback and mirror-normalization guards remain conditional.

Generic getFromEntity/getAllFromEntity repair only with their nonzero explicit repair argument. Conditional repair skips already populated field1 unless refresh is selected; absent field0/field1 can be recreated from integer field3.

Actual ordinary face getAll and getOldest paths pass repair0. The ordinary new-environment getSurfaceIdRep path then reads actual field1 via getGcSurfaceIdRep. It does not independently guarantee rebinding of missing or stale runtime owners.

Successful moPart named partition load enumerates actual bodies and installs BODY_RECIPE model ownership. That provides the model context required by mirror resolution, but this inspected function does not itself prove owner-mirror repair before downstream collection.
